propositions: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object in a reply, allowing schema-valid decoys (tool results, examples, quoted records) to defeat the real payload appearing later
five historical recurrences of structured-output extraction failures stem from one defect class triggered by routine model swaps and provider cutover events
the prompted path requires hardened schema-filtered candidate selection with last-valid-wins, explicit sentinel output channels, and opt-in replayable raw-reply artifacts on parse failure
provider-native structured output must be gated by measured thinking-compatibility per model, not blanket application, with Bedrock SDK floor raised to support outputConfig
before/after raw-output distributions and cell-by-cell measured capability data must be recorded as deterministic artifacts to prevent future regressions
